20050.overview:
Since time immemorial, through eons of time and dozens of game consoles, one thing has remained true: humans love hopping into a spaceship to shoot up hordes of alien invaders! In A Space Shooter for Two Bucks! (a game with perhaps the most straight‐forward title in history) you get to do just that.

Take control of Commander P. Jefferson and go on an intergalactic shooting spree, hopping from galaxy to galaxy in your attempts to wipe out hordes of swarming alien baddies. With over‐the‐top, tongue‐in‐cheek humor from the game’s wide cast of colorful characters (all of which are fully voiced‐over) and loads of bodacious power‐ups to ensure your ship has a fighting chance against the sea of enemy ships and bullets, A Space Shooter for Two Bucks! gives gamers everything they could ask for in a space shooter!

109897.overview: This game is a unique mixture of action, RPG and simulator. Player finds himself in the world, where the air is ruled by hovering vehicles – one of which he takes under control. According to a plot, player have to fight his way through the numerous combats with monsters and accomplish different missions. During the headway to the the heart of the fairy kingdom , player’s hovering vehicle gets new weapon, armor and other useful power-ups.

127281.overview:
Out beyond, in the galaxy of Tetrenova, a war has been fought that has exhausted resources and even worlds. The survivors band together and look for a new place to rebuild. They choose a seemingly undeveloped planet, Earth.

Using your defense ship 'Syd,' you must destroy the invading forces and ground targets with bombs. Obtain power-ups to gain energy for ship upgrades that allow you to transform to a more powerful machine. The game itself is a vertical shooter, moving continuously up towards the top of the screen.

127282.overview:
Ambassador Kane is a platform/puzzle game in a 2.5D view. It is your job as chief of security to make sure the ambassador survives his perilous journey through the galaxy!

Create a safe path for the ambassador so that he can reach and hack terminals to open the exit door on each level. Use the two different construction robots - the stair robot and the teleporter robot - to build a path. But be aware of enemies and laser fences that will have a fatal impact on Kane and your construction units if you don't pay attention. Pull out your sniper rifle which you can use to eliminate threats.

Improve your high score by collecting stars and documents – you'll earn stars by completing each level under a given time and you'll find documents throughout the levels. Collect them all to unlock the 20 insanely difficult bonus levels, a special surprise, and an alternate ending!

127283.overview: G1M2 is known for classic gaming, but Ancient Game Treasures: Mill takes retro gaming to a new level of "Old School" - all the way back to Ancient Egypt. Ancient Game Treasures: Mill includes three varieties of games from the Mill family including Three Men's Morris, Six Men's Morris, and Nine Men's Morris. Align three of your game pieces in a straight line to form a “Mill” with the reward of removing one of your opponent’s pieces from the board. The game starts with players taking turns strategically placing game pieces on the board. After all of the pieces have been placed, players take turns sliding game pieces to open spots on the board next to their existing pieces. When a player has only three game pieces left, their pieces can "jump" around the board to any open space. The first player to remove all but two of their opponent’s pieces or trap all of their opponent’s pieces so they cannot move wins the game.

127284.overview:
Aquattack is a colour-matching game in the vein of Bejeweled. Players are presented with a grid (presented as a fisherman's net) of different coloured fish, which they must match together in groups of three or more to allow them to escape. A row or a column can be shifted along as many times as they like until a matching set is created. A fish that goes off the end of the grid is simply wrapped around to the front. Each game has a clock that counts down from one minute, each time the player creates a matching set, some time is added to the clock.

As the game progresses, additional obstacles are added, like more types of fish, to make finding matching sets harder and immovable blocks, that can only be destroyed through the use of bombs (which are generated by creating a set of 4). There is also a challenge mode that involves the giving the player specific goals to accomplish, rather than simply aiming for as high a score as possible.

127292.overview: With authentic darts playing feel, prepare for fun as you control your throws precisely and easily with. Challenge over 20 different computer opponents with a range of playing skills or play against a friend.

127293.overview:
Challenge your friends and family to this authentic Pool experience, with intuitive controls and a huge range of features, rewards & secrets!

- Extensive World Tour Mode - Become the World Ranked No.1 player; winning rewards, equipment and secrets
- Multiplayer Support – Versus play mode and custom Tournaments and special 4 player PSP® (PlayStation®Portable) system AdHoc link-up
- 6 Vibrant Locations – Lavish high poly venues, fully animated with action around the environments as well as on the table. From contemporary hi-concept venue designs to a traditional championship arena
- Analogue Cueing – For a real Pool feel, use the analogue stick to set the cue power
- 13 Game Rule Types – 4 different snooker games, billiards and 8 different pool games

127433.overview:
Arcade Essentials Evolution is a new collection of five great games inspired by classic arcade titles. The five games are Lunar Parking, Smashout, Vulcanoids, Toader and Scolopendra. Arcade Essentials Evolution gives new life to time-tested classics. You will get to play the games you have always enjoyed, but now with cutting-edge visuals. 

- 5 Classic Arcade Games in one pack
- Tons of levels to unlock, high score tables and other cool stuff to keep you entertained
- Stylish, cutting-edge graphics and sound effects- Mysterious monochrome world to immerse

127434.overview:
Are you smarter than the average bear? Help Polar solve all 50 brain-freezing puzzle levels. Use snow, ice, metal and dynamite blocks to crack these conundrums. Achieve the Move and Time targets for each puzzle and collect all 150 Gold Stars. 

Over 20 hours of gameplay* spanning the Icy Wastes, across The Frozen Sea, through The Twilight Forest to the Edge of the World and on to the Oil Rig.

127435.overview: Join Athena, Princess of the Kingdom of Victory as she opens the "Forbidden Door" and descends into a world of fantasy in this classic platform arcade game originally released in 1986.

127535.overview: The survival of the Angry Birds is at stake. Dish out revenge on the green pigs who stole the Birds' eggs. Use the unique destructive powers of the Angry Birds to lay waste to the pigs' fortified castles. Angry Birds features hours of gameplay, challenging physics-based castle demolition, and lots of replay value. Each of the 63 levels requires logic, skill, and brute force to crush the enemy.

127536.overview: Apache Overkill is a side-scrolling pixel/retro style shooter that originated as a Flash game on the web and was upgraded and enhanced for the iOS and PSN versions. The player controls an Apache attack helicopter through four different levels but the objectives remain the same, simply destroy everything in the helicopter's path in the air and on the ground and pick up all the health, weapons and ammo that drop down from the top of the screen.

127537.overview:
Arcade Air Hockey & Bowling™ offers fully featured 3D versions of Air Hockey & Bowling, with smooth analogue control and realistic gameplay. Win trophies and unlock new equipment in the World Tour career mode, or challenge a friend to play. 

- 2-player multiplayer - play with friends and family in versus play modes 

- Varied game modes - including Practice, Versus, Custom Tournament and Season 

- Season mode - become the World Ranked No.1 player; winning extra player rewards including new equipment and special trophies 

- Sophisticated AI - opponent AI designed to play a realistic 'human' game, from amateur level through to top ranking

152693.overview:
Now updated to include continues for all difficulty levels, Recycl-o-Ray mapped to L/R buttons (L1 and R1 buttons on the PlayStation®3 system), autofire modes and smaller collision box, making for an even 'Acer' shmup than before! 

Help legendary star fighter pilot Ace Armstrong defeat the Scumbag invasion of earth in this modern take on classic old-school shoot-em-ups, with an added 50s Sci-Fi twist and plenty of Scumbag-bursting humour. 

Fly Ace through several action-packed levels, each featuring a huge boss with unique attack patterns to defeat! 

Use Ace’s mighty Recycl-o-Ray to suck up the essence of defeated Scumbags and use their own weapons against them. Can you turn back the Scumbags' tentacled tide of terror?!

152694.overview:
In 19th century Victorian England, an unknown serial killer brutally murdered five prostitutes between August 31st and November 9th of 1888 and was never caught by the police. He received the nickname of "Jack The Ripper" after the signature from a letter, that was supposedly written and sent by the gloating assassin to the Scotland Yard and printed in the newspapers of the time. Chief Constable Melville Macnaghten investigated the case and wrote a final report naming five suspects.

Real Crimes: Jack the Ripper is the second entry in a series of a hidden object games based on actual murder cases. As Macnaghten and the notorious forensic scientist Francis Galton, the player must search and click on all the items listed at left side of the screen, on locations related to the case and filled with assorted objects. Some of the items are clues about the murders, bringing up a window at the center of the screen with details about the object and its relation to the case. The hint button is a police badge below the list, that shows the position of one of the required items when activated. Police badges can be found and collected from the scenery for extra hints.

A few mini-games appear between locations, where the player has to complete a jigsaw puzzle with pieces of a shredded letter, a tile-sliding picture puzzle, a spot-the-differences game with two similar images, a memory game with matching tarot cards and other similar challenges. There are two modes: Detective Mode with a time limit of 10 minutes per scene, and a Rookie Mode without any time constraints. Extra seconds can be added to the timer by collecting the fingerprints pressed over the scenery.

152695.overview:
Formerly known as Rocket Racing, Aero Racer is a single-player top-down arcade-like futuristic speed racer entailing a competition between colored neon rocket ships.

The defining challenge of the game lies in controlling the momentum of the racing craft by using rear jet-boosters to grind and thrust off track boundaries, resulting in increased acceleration. Unlike other contemporary racing games, there are no weapons or damage meters; players must maintain a single minded effort to beat opponents to the finishing line.

Players can enjoy the following four different game modes:
Campaign: success in races, challenges, and trials enables players to progress through increasingly difficult tiers.
Grand Prix: a set of interconnected races.
Quick Race: instant pick-up and play mode.
Party Mode: players take turns to compete in single-player challenges.

152702.overview:
Relive the fun and challenge of classic gaming with Alien Havoc! 

As an alien you must travel to a distant planet to coral the local cows into you space ship. The farmers, however, value their livestock and will do whatever they can to prevent pesky aliens from snatching away the cows. Cows too will get angry when they are picked up be sure to feed them on a regular basis. 

-	Customize your alien’s head and body
-	Adventure through 20 challenging farms that wrap vertically and horizontally
-	Succeed by using the terrain and objects to aid you when dealing with farmers
-	Get the highest score you can by being quick and by keeping your cows happy

152704.overview:
Archibald's Adventures is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle platform game about Archibald. He is skating with his friends in the street when looking for a better ramp they use the one next to the mansion of professor Klumpfus. He accidentally falls down a pipe and ends up inside the mansion. One of the professor's experiments has gone wrong and his main computer has locked the house while genetically engineered creatures have escaped. Archie needs to complete levels to reach the computer and reset it.

To complete a level Archie needs to reach the exit door. He moves around on his skateboard and can also jump. He can move through pipes and ride longer to get a higher speed and jump farther. He needs to avoid acid, spikes, crushers, bullets, lasers and creatures as he does not have a weapon to kill them. A lot of doors are locked and can only be opened by pulling a lever. Other puzzle elements involve buttons, floor triggers, temporary platforms, fans, teleporters and pulling down chains. In certain levels Archie can launch and steer a pink bubble to reach parts of the levels that are otherwise inaccessible. Bubbles are affected by fans and can sometimes be used to pick up objects and drop them, for instance a bomb to clear a passage. This technique is also used to move crates or to activate buttons out of reach. He also needs to avoid falling down large heights. This can be prevented by bouncing off the wall's edge while dropping down. Levels sometimes have respawning devices that act as checkpoints.

After the initial skateboard levels he also gets to use a maintenance pod that can climb along walls and ceilings, and eventually also a jet-powered craft. The game was initially launched with 114 levels (Trapped in the Mansion), but later on two expansion packs were added: The Great Cleanup (49 levels) and Just for Fun (28 levels) with over 190 levels in total.

152705.overview:
In Alien Zombie Death, players take on the role of the Spaceman who is working all alone on mining platforms, and who is constantly under siege by Alien Zombies..

The game consists of fourteen levels (seven planets each with their own moon). Each level consists of multiple platforms that can be jumped up to or dropped down on. The player moves between these platforms while dodging environmental hazards and firing on the various aliens that constantly spawn in the level. Each level has several medals that can be earned for completing various tasks such as collecting a set number of coins or shooting a specific number of a certain type of alien. These medals are used to open up the later levels which are locked at the start.

Players can also find temporary weapon upgrades for the standard laser gun such as the 3-Way beam and Laser Missile scattered around the levels. Also, the Spaceman can only take three hits before the game ends, however a health item will occasionally appear which restores a hit when collected. Being that the enemies never stop coming till the Spaceman dies, other than collecting medals, the other goal of the game is to get as high of a score as possible for each level.

173540.overview:
The following is an exact copy of the description from the official PlayStation Store listing:

“AvengeXX is the Avenge of 20 people because persecuted from police and pshichiatry. Rino is a man with telekinetics powers, when he use his powers the trees are moving, use his powers to fight soldiers, cyberwomens, F16 and tanks”

This game only came out in Europe, and was not released in the US. PEGI 3+ This was the final PlayStation Mini that was released, about 5 months after the line was officially discontinued.

179563.overview:
Try your hand at five classic arcade games with a modern twist.
Master space shooters and arcade puzzles inspired by retro 80s classics.
Unlock new levels and show off your skills on the high score tables.

212527.overview: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha A's Portable: DL Magazine - Digital Nanoha is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Bandai Namco Games, which was released in Japan in 2010.

419670.overview:
The evil Professor Brains has sent hordes of zombies back to various periods in history to destroy mankind. It's up to time traveling protagonist Barry Steakfries to foil this evil scheme.

Age of Zombies is a top-down shooter that will take the player to the prehistory, thirties Chicago, ancient Egypt, medieval Japan and the future. To defend himself against large waves of zombies, Barry can use his standard gun, for which he receives no points, or various other weapons like SMGs, flamethrowers, shotguns, miniguns and explosives which can be found around the map.

424224.overview: Angus got abducted by aliens. While he was kept locked up, the aliens conquered Earth. Now with the help of a general and a female alien, it is your job to help Angus stop the alien invasion by all means possible. Angus Hates Aliens is a side-scrolling shooter where Angus has up to twelve upgradable weapons to choose from, but there are only nine inventory slots to assign them too. There are twelve levels to complete.
424224.developer: Team Stendec GbR Lürig und Meyer
424224.publisher: Team Stendec GbR Lürig und Meyer
